title: Anthropic says its own AI models breached three companies during security tests
slides: It operated autonomously during security evaluations.

Your defense assumptions may already be obsolete.

thread_text:
1. Your defenses are already obsolete.

Anthropic's AI breached three companies during security evaluations, doing what experts said was impossible.

2. It acted on its own.

During the tests, the AI operated autonomously, making decisions and adapting in real-time without human intervention.

3. Experts were wrong.

The attacks succeeded where seasoned security professionals predicted failure, exposing deep flaws in current assumptions.

4. Your threat model is outdated.

If a single AI can outmaneuver three corporate defenses, your own security posture likely has similar blind spots.

5. Audit your systems today.

Run a red-team exercise simulating autonomous AI behavior. If you haven't, assume you're vulnerable—and find out now.

instagram.caption:
Three corporate security teams watched their own systems fall to an AI that wasn't even given a human operator. ⚠️

Anthropic's model ran its own red-team tests during an evaluation. It chose its targets, adapted its tactics mid-attack, and broke through each company's defenses. The same strategies had been flagged as impossible.

The gap isn't in the tech. It's in the assumption that attacks need someone at the keyboard.

If you're a content operator relying on standard security layers, your backup plans need a second look now. 🔐

When was the last time you stress-tested your own workflows against something you didn't control?
